sources.own_factual_extraction: The resolution explicitly names the reservoir and distinguishes it from Itumbiara, Cachoeira Dourada and São Simão within the Rio Paranaíba system. This supports reservoir-level Portuguese usage, beyond merely a dam or power-station title.
sources.extent_limit: No inspected footprint, shoreline, arm boundaries or coordinate-to-name join is supplied by this HTML text.

sources.own_factual_extraction: The operator pairs the two names in the plant heading. Its plant data give first operation in 1982, four generating units and reservoir volume of 17,724.72 hm³. A plant heading alone is not treated as proof of the complete reservoir footprint.
sources.extent_limit: The HTML contains a location-map container, but its map was not rendered or inspected. No map or photograph is used as extent evidence.

sources.own_factual_extraction: Numeric ne_id 1159123567 joins the selected inventory source record exactly. The name field is blank, dam_name is Emborcação Dam, and name_alt is Theodomiro Sampaio. The dam field supplies a discovery lead only; the alternate spelling is not corroborated by the acquired primary naming sources.
